title: Improving Person-Level External Transfer on V-COCO
description: Versioned code, portable evidence, and an independent technical report for a locked person-level V-COCO study. A scale-conditioned DINOv2 stack improves official-test macro-F1 from 0.7071 to 0.8663 under a split-preserving protocol, with paired image-cluster uncertainty, calibration analysis, mechanism studies, and a complete evidence manifest. The release also retains the source-overlap-controlled POLAR benchmark that established the historical baseline.
